Hippodamia: wife of Pelops, daughter of Oenomaus, in Greek myth
Italus: eponymous hero of Italy and king of the Oenotrians
Leucippus: figure of Greek mythology, son of Oenomaus
Oeneus: king of Calydon, father of Meleager
Oenone: mountain nymph of Phrygia, first wife of Paris
Oenotrus: hero of Greek myth, eponym of the Oenotrians
Periboea: daughter of Hipponous and wife of Oeneus in Greek mythology
